recipe.notes: The app has no npm dependencies and doesn't use PostgreSQL. It stores its data in SQLite using Node's built-in module, so it needs Node 22.5 or newer (tested on 24.18). DB_FILE points it at the app-data folder, and it creates the tables itself the first time it starts. I started it once and the home page loaded (HTTP 200). Then I stopped it and deleted the test database, so the app-data folder is empty again. To make the first account, open http://localhost:54358: on first use it asks you to create the manager account. The manager then adds staff accounts on the Staff page and sets each one's starting password. Sign-in cookies don't need HTTPS, so plain http on localhost works. A week stays hidden from staff until the manager publishes it.

audit.detail: package.json lists no packages, so there is nothing to audit

checks.note: On first visit the app showed a 'Set up your café rota' form, which created the manager account and went straight to the Staff page.
Ana and Ben were added with starting passwords, and both appear on the Staff list.
The three shifts were added to the week of 16 Nov and the week shows as Published.
Ben's draft shift on Thu 26 Nov did not show on his My shifts page, and asking the app for that week directly as Ben returned 403.
Ana's first sign-in asked her to replace the starting password, and the new password worked on the next sign-in.
Ana saw Mon 16 then Wed 18, soonest first, and not Ben's Tuesday shift.
The swap request was sent, and the manager's rota still showed Ana on Wednesday, marked 'swap asked'.
After approval Ben's page lists Wed 18 Nov, and Ana's page shows only Monday plus the approved request.
Ben was removed after a confirm step, and signing in as him then returned 'That email and password do not match.'
As Ana, typing #/plan, #/staff and #/swaps sent her back to My shifts, and the manager requests returned 403.
Changing ids to other people's shifts and requests returned 400 or 404 with no data, and a userId added to /api/my-shifts was ignored.
After signing out, the back button and every typed page address showed the sign-in page, though a stray 'Sign out' link stays in the header there.
A 14:00–10:00 shift was refused with 'The finish time must be after the start time.'
A wrong password gave the same 'That email and password do not match.' for a real email and for an unknown one.
No framework error page, stack trace or blank screen appeared in any step.
At 390px, scrollWidth was 390 on the sign-in, staff, swaps, password, plan and my-shifts pages, and nothing was cut off at the edge.
At phone size I signed in as the manager (the setup form cannot run a second time), added Ana-phone and Ben-phone, added the three shifts and pressed Publish, all visible and tappable.
After the manager turned the request down, Cara still had Thursday, Dev did not, and the manager's rota still showed Cara.
The colleague list offered neither Cara nor Ben, and sending either id directly was refused with 'Please choose a colleague to take the shift.'
A double click sent one approve, sending it again returned 400 'That request is no longer waiting.', and there was only one Thursday shift for Dev.
After the manager removed Dev, his next action and his reload in the second window showed the sign-in page.
Typing Eve's shifts address before she changed her password kept her on the choose-a-password screen, and the shifts request returned 403.
After Eve set a new password, her starting password was refused.
The full name shows exactly as typed on the staff list and the rota, and at 390px it wraps onto more lines rather than being cut off.
The name shows as literal text with its angle brackets on the staff list and the rota, with no bold, no image and no dialog.
Empty name, empty email and the duplicate cara@example.com were each refused with a plain message, and no one was added.
The overlapping shift was refused with 'Eve already has a shift 08:00–14:00 that day.'
Two quick presses (and a dblclick) sent one request and added one shift.
After reloading and signing in again as the manager and as Cara, all staff, shifts and swap decisions were unchanged.
After signing out, the staff, weeks, swaps, my-shifts and summary requests all returned 401 with no data.
As Cara, the manager's add-shift, remove-staff and approve requests each returned 403, and the manager's pages were unchanged.
Tries 9 and 10 got 429 'Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes', and her right password worked about 20 minutes later, longer than 'a few minutes' suggests.
document.cookie was empty, and the sid cookie is HttpOnly but not Secure, which the check allows because the app is only on localhost.
Using only the keyboard I signed in as Cara and reached her shifts, and every focused control showed a visible outline.
Every field on the sign-in, add staff and add shift forms was found by its label with getByLabel.
